note: exact_acc == MRR@10 over file-level targets (a regression gate, not an absolute benchmark: the generation-time self-retrieval filter admits only questions the retriever already answers at rank <= 10, so found_rate starts at 1.0 by construction). Tolerance 0.10: scoring is deterministic on a fixed index, but the index churns with the code; the gate targets the silently-broken-embedder/index class. Regenerate the suite (scripts/generate_retrieval_eval_data.py) when errors exceed ~10% of n.
